opportunities.title: ERC Consolidator Grant 2027 - ERC-2027-COG
opportunities.deadline_timezone: Brussels time (CET); exact hour not in portal data (ERC standard 17:00)
opportunities.deadline_text: Deadline date: 12 January 2027 (portal topic data, status Open)
opportunities.funding_text: Consolidator Grants may be awarded up to a maximum of EUR 2 000 000 for a period of 60 months. Additional funding up to EUR 1 000 000 can be requested (up to EUR 2 000 000 for PIs relocating to the EU/AC from elsewhere). Call budget EUR 618.5M, ~296 grants.
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Individual Principal Investigator (any nationality) with PhD defended 1 Jan 2012 - 31 Dec 2021, hosted by a legal entity in an EU Member State or Associated Country
opportunities.eligible_countries: Host institution in EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country; PI of any nationality
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Bioversity International (legal entity in Italy, an EU Member State) could act as Host Institution and sign the Host Institution Support Letter; CIAT Colombia cannot host. PI would need to be based at the host (ERC requires substantial time in EU/AC).
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: PhD defended in the 5-15 year window before 1 Jan 2027 (1 Jan 2012 - 31 Dec 2021); evidence of research independence; no previous CoG; binding Host Institution support letter
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Host must be in EU/Associated Country; fieldwork worldwide allowed
opportunities.cofunding_details: 100% of eligible direct costs + 25% flat-rate indirect
opportunities.eligible_activities: Frontier research in any field, bottom-up (e.g., EO/AI crop phenotyping, climate-crop modelling)
opportunities.required_documents: Proposal Part B1 (extended synopsis, CV, track record) and B2 (scientific proposal), Host Institution Support Letter, PhD certificate
opportunities.application_procedure: Single-stage submission via Funding & Tenders Portal; two-step evaluation with interview
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Bottom-up: researcher's core expertise (RS + ML phenotyping, crop modelling under climate/SAI scenarios) fits ERC panels
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: 5-year EUR 2M grant would build an independent EO/AI-for-agriculture team hosted at Bioversity (Rome); high prestige
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Highly competitive; needs strong independent track record; ~10 weeks to deadline; PhD date must fall in window (not confirmed here)
opportunities.recommendation: Pursue only if the PI's PhD defence falls between 2012 and 2021 and the publication record shows independence; otherwise target later ERC calls. Confirm Bioversity is willing to host.
opportunities.next_action: Check PhD defence date against the 2012-2021 window; request host letter from Alliance grants office by mid-December 2026

evidence.eligibility_quote: The Principal Investigators will be eligible for a Consolidator Grant if they have defended their PhD in the five to fifteen-year period preceding the 1st of January 2027. Cut-off dates: Successful defence of PhD between 1 January 2012 and 31 December 2021 (inclusive)
evidence.staff_costs_quote: Additional funding up to EUR 1 000 000 can be requested to cover further eligible costs for any cost category
